scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web start" "pnpm --filter api start:prod"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @monorepo/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
